name: Robalzotan
summary: Robalzotan is a selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, gastrointestinal disorders, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and overactive bladder but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Robalzotan (INN, BAN; developmental code names NAD-299 and AZD-7371) is a selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, gastrointestinal disorders, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and overactive bladder but was never marketed.

uses.text: Robalzotan (INN, BAN; developmental code names NAD-299 and AZD-7371) is a selective serotonin 5-HT1A receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder, anxiety disorders, gastrointestinal disorders, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and overactive bladder but was never marketed.

fact.en: Robalzotan blocks 5-HT1A receptors. The idea was that blocking these brakes on serotonin neurons would make SSRIs work faster.
fact.zh: Robalzotan 會阻斷 5-HT1A 受體。其構想是：阻斷這些作為血清素神經元煞車的受體，能讓 SSRI 更快發揮作用。
fact.zhHans: Robalzotan 会阻断 5-HT1A 受体。其构想是：阻断这些作为血清素神经元煞车的受体，能让 SSRI 更快发挥作用。
